text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey! You know our day off yesterday? Well, I saw the cuuutest black cat at the park.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I was drawing a magic circle on the ground and it kept running around my feet! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It must have noticed that I'm a witch. I think maybe it wants to be my familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'm in such a good mood, I think I might just try today!
